name: homebrew-formula
body: Homebrew formula: the tap's `kalide` formula (`Formula/kalide.rb`, tap `really-knows-ai/kalide`) with a custom download strategy that uses `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN` to fetch the arch-matching asset — `kalide-darwin-arm64` on Apple silicon, `kalide-darwin-amd64` on Intel — from the private GitHub Release of really-knows-ai/kalide, based on the running Mac's architecture. The formula declares `license "Apache-2.0"`, replacing the current `license :cannot_represent` at `Formula/kalide.rb:43`, consistent with requirements.requirement.license.
